import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 3, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 3, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
K = 6
PROJ = 16
HID = 32


def fp_pool(t, dy, dx):
    if dy * dx == 1:
        return t, t, t
    q = F.pad(t, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
    mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
    mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
    av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
    return mx, mn, av


class LayerGateHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, z):
        super().__init__()
        self.z = int(z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.lay = nn.Conv2d(c, K * self.z, 1)
        self.occ = nn.Conv2d(c, self.z, 1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, PROJ, 1)
        self.land = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(2 * self.z, self.z, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(2 * K + 3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        b, _, yy, xx = f.shape
        z = self.z
        lay = self.lay(f)
        occ = self.occ(f)
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), land, mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.land, self.mix, self.outs):
            lmx, lmn, _ = fp_pool(lay, dy, dx)
            omx, omn, _ = fp_pool(occ, dy, dx)
            pmx, pmn, pav = fp_pool(p, dy, dx)
            w = torch.softmax(land(torch.cat([omx, omn], dim=1)), dim=1).unsqueeze(1)
            gmx = (lmx.reshape(b, K, z, yy, xx) * w).sum(2)
            gmn = (lmn.reshape(b, K, z, yy, xx) * w).sum(2)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([gmx, gmn, pmx, pmn, pav], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = LayerGateHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, spec.Z)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 3, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

HID = 40
PROJ = 16
MIX = 24


def fp_pool(t, dy, dx):
    if dy * dx == 1:
        return t, t, t
    q = F.pad(t, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
    mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
    mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
    av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
    return mx, mn, av


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        cin = 12 + spec.in_channels + self.z
        self.enc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, HID, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(HID, HID, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(HID, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, MIX, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(MIX, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * HID, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def voxels(self, obs):
        b, c, yy, xx = obs.shape
        z = self.z
        vox = obs[:, :4 * z].reshape(b, 4, z, yy, xx)
        pad = F.pad(vox, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1))
        loc = torch.cat([vox, pad[:, :, :z], pad[:, :, 2:]], dim=1).permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4)
        col = obs.unsqueeze(1).expand(b, z, c, yy, xx)
        zid = torch.eye(z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).reshape(1, z, z, 1, 1).expand(b, z, z, yy, xx)
        return torch.cat([loc, col, zid], dim=2).reshape(b * z, 12 + c + z, yy, xx)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        b, _, yy, xx = obs.shape
        z = self.z
        h = self.enc(self.voxels(obs))
        p = self.proj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            mx, mn, av = fp_pool(p, dy, dx)
            s = out(F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1))))
            s = s.reshape(b, z, yy * xx)
            res.append(torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        hv = h.reshape(b, z, HID, yy, xx)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([hv.mean((1, 3, 4)), hv.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

        res = []

                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))

        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
GP = 8
GH = 256


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        n_cells = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.gproj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, GP, 1)
        self.gfc1 = nn.Linear(GP * n_cells + 64, GH)
        self.gfc2 = nn.Linear(GH, int(spec.n_place))
        nn.init.zeros_(self.gfc2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.gfc2.bias)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        local = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        gf = F.relu(self.gproj(f)).flatten(1)
        dense = self.gfc2(F.relu(self.gfc1(torch.cat([gf, g], dim=1))))
        place = local + dense
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

Each cell token then outputs one logit per brick type. Attention gives every cell whole-board context, for ordering and overhang supports, without assuming any channel layout or anchor convention. import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.0007, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

D = 48
HEADS = 4
FF = 96
LAYERS = 2
PH = 48


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, h, ff):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = h
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.o = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, ff), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(ff, d))

    def forward(self, x):
        b, n, d = x.shape
        hd = d // self.h
        qkv = self.qkv(self.ln1(x)).reshape(b, n, 3, self.h, hd).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv[0], qkv[1], qkv[2]
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(hd), dim=-1)
        y = torch.matmul(a, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, n, d)
        x = x + self.o(y)
        x = x + self.ff(self.ln2(x))
        return x


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        n_cells = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.n_types = int(spec.n_types)
        self.embed = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, D, 3, padding=1)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, n_cells, D) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(D, HEADS, FF) for _ in range(LAYERS)])
        self.lnf = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.ph = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(D, PH), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(PH, self.n_types))
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        b = obs.shape[0]
        x = self.embed(obs).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2) + self.pos
        for blk in self.blocks:
            x = blk(x)
        x = self.lnf(x)
        place = self.ph(x).transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, -1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([x.mean(1), x.amax(1)], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


def make_views(obs, square):
    v = [obs, obs.flip(2), obs.flip(3), obs.flip(2).flip(3)]
    if square:
        t = obs.transpose(2, 3)
        v = v + [t, t.flip(2), t.flip(3), t.flip(2).flip(3)]
    return torch.cat(v, dim=1)


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.square = int(spec.Y) == int(spec.X)
        nv = 8 if self.square else 4
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(nv * spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(make_views(obs, self.square))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
D = 48
H = 6
OH = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.yy = int(spec.Y)
        self.xx = int(spec.X)
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.k = nn.Linear(WIDTH, D)
        self.v = nn.Linear(WIDTH, D)
        self.krow = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(self.yy, D) * 0.7)
        self.kcol = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(self.xx, D) * 0.7)
        self.qt = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(self.nt, D) * 0.5)
        self.qr = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(self.yy, D) * 0.7)
        self.qc = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(self.xx, D) * 0.7)
        self.o1 = nn.Linear(D, OH)
        self.qb = nn.Linear(D, OH)
        self.gq = nn.Linear(64, OH)
        self.o2 = nn.Linear(OH, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        b = obs.shape[0]
        n = self.yy * self.xx
        p = self.nt * n
        hd = D // H
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        tok = f.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        kpos = (self.krow[:, None, :] + self.kcol[None, :, :]).reshape(n, D)
        k = self.k(tok) + kpos.unsqueeze(0)
        v = self.v(tok)
        q = (self.qt[:, None, None, :] + self.qr[None, :, None, :] + self.qc[None, None, :, :]).reshape(p, D)
        kh = k.reshape(b, n, H, hd).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        vh = v.reshape(b, n, H, hd).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        qh = q.reshape(p, H, hd).permute(1, 0, 2).unsqueeze(0)
        att = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(qh, kh.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(hd), dim=-1)
        o = torch.matmul(att, vh).permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(b, p, D)
        h = F.relu(self.o1(o) + self.qb(q).unsqueeze(0) + self.gq(g).unsqueeze(1))
        place = self.o2(h).squeeze(-1)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
GP = 16
GH = 256


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        n_cells = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.gproj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, GP, 1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(GP * n_cells + 64, GH)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(GH, int(spec.n_actions))
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.fc2.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.fc2.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GH + 64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        gf = F.relu(self.gproj(f)).flatten(1)
        h = F.relu(self.fc1(torch.cat([gf, g], dim=1)))
        logits = self.fc2(h)
        value = self.value_head(torch.cat([h, g], dim=1)).squeeze(1)
        return logits, value


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting architecture scored 0.000 on both seeds. That means the default setup gets almost no learning signal, not that it falls just short. With the default recipe it gets about 131k steps in batches of 4,096, so only 32 policy updates, and a fresh design needs about 10 correct placements in a row plus DONE. I think the number of updates and the credit for the +1 bonus for an exact build are the most likely bottlenecks, so round 1 tests the recipe first. Smaller rollout batches give many more updates at the same compute. Fewer PPO epochs buy more samples. A higher gamma keeps more of the end-of-episode bonus. The third candidate keeps the better-looking recipe and changes the architecture. Its head learns a weighting over layers for where each brick will land, which matches the task: a placement is right only if the layer it drops to matches the target under the whole footprint. Results of 0 versus 0 between candidates will not separate ideas.
analyses.2: All four results are 0.000, including the training success rate. The two recipe changes (more updates and more samples) did not help, and neither did the gated-layer head built on a 2D trunk. So the bottleneck is probably not the recipe. A correct placement depends on a 3D lookup. The brick lands at the highest column height under its footprint, and the target must have cells at exactly that layer, with no target cells left sealed underneath. 2D features that mix whole columns and are then max/min-pooled cannot easily read the target at a landing layer that changes from place to place. Next I will try a voxel-level design. Each (layer, cell) gets its own learned features from its own layer and its neighbours, its whole column, and a one-hot layer index. Footprint pooling and scoring happen at every layer, and a logsumexp over layers combines them. The three candidates are this base, the base plus 2D context, and the base with a different recipe.
analyses.3: All six trials scored 0 on dev, on both seeds, and also 0 training success in the last 10% of training. So no change has given any signal yet. Three kinds of head (pooled 2D, layer-gated, voxel per layer) all failed, and so did recipes with 2 to 4 epochs at 127k to 232k steps. One lever is untested. ppo_epochs=1 gives about 3.25x the samples (about 426k steps), and the trend so far (fewer epochs means more data) points that way. The task also says the world may differ from its description. The voxel heads rely on the stated channel layout and the pooled heads on top-left anchoring, so either could be wrong. Heads that make no such assumption are a cheap hedge: a dense global head, or attention over all cells. All three candidates use the 1-epoch recipe. Candidate 1 shows the recipe effect on its own; candidates 2 and 3 add heads that work whatever the anchor or channel convention is.
analyses.4: All 9 trials scored exactly 0 on both seeds, and training success was also 0. That held for three model families (pooled conv, voxel, transformer), for 1 to 3 PPO epochs, and for 127k to 408k steps. If the world matched its description, a network that just fills missing target cells with 1x1 bricks should build some small designs without overhangs exactly. A complete failure that ignores both architecture and recipe points to a hidden mismatch, not to capacity or tuning. The most likely mismatch is the frame of the action coordinates: the brick's position in the action index may be transposed or flipped relative to the observation grid. Every local head we tried assumes the action cell (y, x) matches observation cell (y, x), which would make all of them wrong. In this last round all three candidates are robust to that convention: one stacks transformed copies of the observation as input, one uses a learned attention head that maps each action to cells, and one uses a fully dense policy.
